meta.title: Polinom.io
meta.description: Technology consultancy that decomposes business challenges into strategy, engineering, data, and execution.

hero.h1: Business growth has a closed-form solution.
hero.dek: Polinom.io combines strategy, engineering, data, and execution into a single equation for your business — then solves it. No guesswork, no black boxes: every term is accountable to a result.

approach.h2: Every business problem decomposes into terms.
approach.p1: Most consultancies sell you one term at a time — a strategy deck, a dev shop, a data team — and leave you to integrate the rest. We build the whole polynomial: the compounding combination of decisions that actually moves revenue, margin, and speed.
approach.p2: We start by defining your variables — the real constraints of your market, stack, and team — then fit coefficients to them: how much weight strategy carries versus engineering versus data, for your business specifically. The result isn't a template. It's a function tuned to you.

services.p: Each engagement draws on some or all four terms — weighted to where your business needs the most help.

terms.title: Strategy & Advisory
terms.body: Technology roadmaps, build-vs-buy calls, and operating models tied to a P&L, not a slide deck.

terms.title: Software Engineering
terms.body: Product builds, platform modernization, and systems architecture designed to outlast the next funding round.

terms.title: Data & AI
terms.body: Pipelines, applied ML, and decision systems that turn your operational data into a compounding asset.

terms.title: Execution & Delivery
terms.body: The constant term — always present. Embedded delivery teams that ship, monitor, and keep the solution correct.

process.p: The same four-step method underlies every engagement, scaled to the size of your equation.

steps.title: Discover
steps.body: Stakeholder interviews, systems audit, and market constraints mapped before a single coefficient is set.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: Strategy and architecture weighted to your actual data, team, and timeline — not a generic playbook.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Embedded engineers and data specialists ship in short, reviewable increments alongside your team.

steps.title: Scale
steps.body: Launch, instrument, and iterate — so the curve keeps rising after the engagement ends.

contact.note: Engagements typically begin within two weeks.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what information Polinom.io collects when you visit this site, and why.
privacy.pBooking: When you book a call through the scheduler embedded on this site, Calendly collects the information you provide directly — typically your name, email address, and anything you write in the booking form. That information is used to confirm, remind, and (if needed) reschedule the call, and to prepare for the conversation. It is handled under Calendly's own privacy policy, since the booking flow runs on Calendly's infrastructure, not ours.
privacy.pEmail: If you write to hello@polinom.io directly, we keep that correspondence to respond to you and, where relevant, to follow up about a potential engagement. We don't add your email to any marketing list without asking first.
privacy.pAnalytics: With your consent (see the banner shown on your first visit), this site uses Google Analytics to understand which pages are visited and how. Analytics cookies are not set until you accept them, and you can decline without losing access to anything on the site. You can withdraw consent at any time by clearing your browser's cookies for this site.
privacy.pRights: You can decline analytics cookies, and you can always reach out to hello@polinom.io to ask what information we hold about you or to request it be deleted.
privacy.pContact: For anything about this policy, write to hello@polinom.io.
